title: Coin Collect
blurb: A bright two-note coin pickup blip, straight out of the 8-bit era. Early arcade hardware could only produce a handful of simple waveforms, so designers made rewards short, high, and rising — a shape the brain reads as "good thing happened" without any training. That constraint accidentally created the template every reward sound still follows. Play it when anything goes right: a donation on stream, a correct answer, a successfully executed parallel park. Synthesised from scratch in the arcade tradition, so it's original audio you can use anywhere.
origin: Original 8-bit style synthesis inspired by arcade coin pickups.
